findings.session_summary: Initial meeting focused on defining a practical step regarding school transport safety (specifically a nervous crossing). The student agreed to record a manageable action but expressed uncertainty about an approved alternative route.
findings.primary_concern: Transport safety and route uncertainty affecting school attendance/participation.
next_steps: Record a manageable step regarding the route.
Clarify if an approved alternative route exists.
uncertainties: Whether an approved alternative route exists.
findings.conclusion: Session established a focus on practical steps rather than judgment. The main barrier (transport safety/uncertainty) remains unresolved, and no external support has been delivered yet.

findings.session_summary: Review of the previous agreed step (recording journey times). The student reported completing the specific step but noted the wider school problem persists. Discussed comparing recorded times with timetables.
findings.primary_concern: Persistence of the wider barrier despite completing a small agreed task; uncertainty remains regarding external support eligibility.

intervention.type: Review of completed step and transport assessment comparison

next_steps: Check an alternative departure and write down practicality.
Verify if a teacher can explain procedures for support.
uncertainties: Whether an approved alternative route exists.
findings.conclusion: The student completed the agreed task, but this did not resolve the main barrier. The distinction between completing a small step and resolving the wider issue was reinforced. No external support delivered.

findings.primary_concern: Difficulty persists on some days; uncertainty regarding completion of between-session tasks and lack of confirmed external support.
